description: Fetch complete metadata for a Project Gutenberg book by ID — title, authors (with birth/death years), translators, editors, source bibliographic notes, subjects, bookshelves, languages, copyright status, and the full formats map with download URLs (plain text, HTML, EPUB, cover image, etc.). Use is_readable before gutenberg_get_text; source_notes may identify specific editions.

id.description: Project Gutenberg book ID. Visible in Gutenberg URLs (e.g., gutenberg.org/ebooks/1342) and returned by gutenberg_search_books and gutenberg_browse_popular. Example: 1342 for Pride and Prejudice, 2600 for War and Peace.

name: gutenberg_get_book

birth_year.description: Birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Death year, or null if unknown or still living.

bookshelves.description: Project Gutenberg bookshelf categories (e.g., "Best Books Ever Listings", "Category: Classics of Literature").

copyright.description: Copyright status: false = public domain in the USA, true = under copyright, null = unknown.

download_count.description: Downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot, used for popularity ranking.

birth_year.description: Birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Death year, or null if unknown.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No book exists with the given ID. `catalog_unavailable`: The Project Gutenberg catalog did not answer within the time this server allows for one lookup. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

formats.description: Map of MIME type to download URL. Key types: "text/plain; charset=utf-8" (preferred for gutenberg_get_text), "text/html", "application/epub+zip", "image/jpeg" (cover). Not every format is present for every book.

has_plain_text.description: True if media_type is "Text" and "text/plain; charset=utf-8" is present. HTML-only editions can still have is_readable=true.

is_readable.description: True for non-Sound records with a supported UTF-8 plain-text or HTML format for gutenberg_get_text.

languages.description: Catalog language codes for this edition.

media_type.description: Source media type, such as "Text" or "Sound" (audio). Use is_readable to check reader support.

source_notes.description: Source-provided RDF bibliographic notes in document order, including explicit edition references. [] means inspected with no notes; null means unavailable from this source.

summaries.description: Every summary Gutendex holds for this work, in upstream order. Usually one; some records carry a long and a short variant. Empty when there are none.

summary.description: First entry of summaries — the primary auto-generated summary of the work, or null when Gutendex has none.

translators.description: Translators, if this is a translated work.

birth_year.description: Birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Death year, or null if unknown.

title: Get Gutenberg Book
